opening.argument: The presentation ties the OneCoin opportunity to recruitment-based rewards, not merely to cryptocurrency use. It says that becoming an active marketing partner and building a sales team qualifies participants for bonuses, while describing a bonus plan that lets them offer contacts a way into profiting from cryptocurrency. It also claims that the Split program can double a token portfolio, presenting a concrete portfolio-growth opportunity alongside the recruitment structure. The appeal is intensified by an urgent registration demand and the assertion that only a limited number of positions are available during the first launch phase. Taken together, the promised bonuses, sales-team building, portfolio-doubling claim, and scarcity-based registration appeal establish a commission-driven opportunity centered on recruiting participants.

citations.quote: By becoming an active marketing partner of the ONE network, and by popularizing ONE coin, you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses by building your own sales team
The Split program can double your token's portfolio
Take your chance and register today!
We are in our first launch phase and have a limited number of positions available during this phase
